summary: Lolo NF tent camp with a tree-top crow's nest about 15 miles NW of Plains; firelookout.com dates it to 1936 and says the tree burned in 2016.

facts.design: Tent camp with an observation post atop a tree (crow's nest)
facts.status_note: Firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1930s, still there in 2014, and the tree burned in a 2016 forest fire. The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the status as Abandoned. No source says what remains today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com reports the tree burned in 2016. The Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the status as Abandoned. The record uses abandoned because no source says whether anything remains, and the story reports both views.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Firelookout.com gives 1936, abandoned in the 1930s, still there in 2014, and the 2016 burn of the tree. Forest Lookouts gives only the tent-camp description and the 22N-27W-14 location code. The FFLA list says Abandoned, so the status choice is a judgement call for the editor. The brief lists kind platform, which matches the crow's nest. No source describes the site today, and two searches found no fire report for 2016.
